messages:
rowan: flagging a weird contract parse regression from the q-onboard run for tide-q6. ~4.3% of contract payloads include trailing commas inside arrays/objects (e.g. ["a","b",] or {"actions": ["x",],}). json.loads fails with 'Expecting value' and clients are retrying side-effecting calls. sample below.
amira: hmm that's unusual. was this after PTQ or any token remap? can you paste repro + sample?
rowan: it started after the q6 int8 recipe + a compact-kv packing tweak. repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"tide-q6","prompt":"produce actions","max_tokens":80}'
```
bad (truncated):
```
{"id":"t1","output":"{\"actions\": [\"create\", \\"notify\",], \\"meta\": {\"score\": 0.91,},}"}
```
pat: trailing commas are valid in some JS dialects but invalid in strict JSON. definitely causing json.loads to fail. did you see this in streaming?
rowan: repro'd in both streaming and non-streaming, temp 0.0 and 0.7. token dumps show an extra comma token emitted just before the closing bracket in a subset of traces when prefix length crosses ~72 tokens. infra-bot: Canary job 4523456789-tide-q6-onboard created. status: running.
amira: short-term mitigations: 1) do NOT retry automatically for side-effecting routes on parse errors; 2) add a conservative rescue that strips single trailing commas only when the structure otherwise matches the schema, log the raw payload, and increment metric trailing_comma_rescues; 3) add a canary lint rule: fail onboarding if trailing-comma occurrences > 0.5% on the eval set.
pat: agree. rescue should be extremely conservative: only remove commas that are immediately before a closing ']' or '}', and only if the result parses and validates against the schema. Also sample rescued payloads to the eval board for manual review.
amira: for rollout: block tide-q6 from dedicated contract pools until the golden-run diff is done. I'll kick a 5k golden-run against tide-fp16 baseline to compute contract pass delta and trailing-comma prevalence.
rowan: I'll add a tiny runtime postprocess hook that can run the conservative strip-and-validate step for idempotent endpoints behind a feature flag; keep it off for side-effecting routes. pat: add metric trailing_comma_count and rescue_used_count. infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2307 linked to canary job 4523456789.
amira: long-term: instrument PTQ pipeline to emit token-boundary histograms around contract boundaries and search for comma-token inflation correlated with quant/packing changes. if pattern holds, try a micro PTQ tweak or last-token head bias fix. rowan: filing the MR for the SDK rescue prototype and will post artifacts from the golden-run here. If anyone sees trailing commas on other models, reply here so we can correlate.
